name: Bullhorn
niche: applicant tracking and CRM for staffing agencies
notes: About page says Bullhorn is founder-led and headquartered in Boston; no country or parent company is named. Pricing page lists $99/user/month and $165/user/month. The API docs link on bullhorn.com points to a bullhorn.github.io address. Ingest is via a marketplace of pre-integrated partners. Language menu lists regions, not languages.

review.note: About page says headquartered in Boston with no country named; pages state pricing, partner-only API terms and a partner hub.
